goal.text: Help when someone is hurt after an earthquake.

intro.text: The shaking stopped. Someone in your family hurt their leg.

hint.text: Who can help them the right way?

lesson.text: After the shaking, check yourself and others. Get help for anyone who is hurt.

choices.label: Pull them up to walk
choices.heading: Not safe yet
choices.feedback: Do not move them. Keep them still and get help.

choices.label: Call a grown-up for help
choices.feedback: Good. Keep them still and get help from an adult.

choices.label: Wait for Mom to get up.
choices.feedback: Keep Mom still and get help.

choices.label: Leave them and go outside
choices.feedback: Stay and call for help. They need an adult.
